options.name: Medusa Admin v2 (Extended with Custom UI Routes)
options.multi_tenancy_rls: Store Module + community RLS pattern (not native); requires middleware + PG session vars
options.custom_entities: UI Routes, Widgets, Admin API; sidebar integration, breadcrumbs, dynamic titles
options.approval_workflows: Via Medusa Workflows + custom UI routes; B2B approval module exists
options.audit_logs: Not native; add via middleware / pgaudit / custom table
options.notes: Best for commerce-native screens (products, orders, customers). Platform entities (proposals, reconciliation) feel forced.

options.name: Next.js 15 + Refine (Ant Design) + shadcn/ui

pricing.cloud: Refine Cloud hosting via Netlify included in Pro

options.multi_tenancy_rls: First-class via dataProvider + accessControlProvider (CASL/Cerberos); RLS at PG layer
options.custom_entities: First-class; Refine resources = any entity; Inferencer auto-generates CRUD
options.approval_workflows: Code-first; React Flow / custom state machines; full control
options.audit_logs: Build or integrate (e.g., pgaudit + Refine audit log page)
options.notes: Full control for platform entities. Best paired with Medusa Admin for commerce screens.

options.name: Retool
options.multi_tenancy_rls: Workspaces = tenants; granular RBAC only on Enterprise; audit logs Business+
options.approval_workflows: Retool Workflows + approval blocks; visual builder
options.audit_logs: Business+ (query + user action logs); streaming on Enterprise
options.notes: Expensive at scale; self-host gated to Enterprise. Good for ops panels, not domain admin.

options.name: Appsmith

pricing.model: Cloud Free 5u, Business $15/u/mo, Enterprise $2,500/mo (100u); self-host CE free

options.multi_tenancy_rls: Workspaces + custom roles (Enterprise); audit logs Enterprise
options.custom_entities: Custom pages + JS logic; entities via datasources
options.notes: Strong open-source option; Enterprise needed for SSO/SCIM/audit. CE is capable for many internal tools.

options.name: Forest Admin

pricing.cloud: UI hosted; agent runs on-prem (data never leaves)

options.multi_tenancy_rls: Cross-team workflows, AI agent RBAC, external user provisioning
options.custom_entities: Smart Actions on collections; collections = DB tables
options.audit_logs: Unlimited retention all plans; decision-trace reasoning log
options.notes: Fintech/ops focus; pricing per Action + user. Not ideal for catalogue domain.

options.name: Directus

pricing.model: Cloud Core $89/mo (3 seats, 25 collections), Team $588/mo, Enterprise custom; self-host free <$5M rev (Open Innovation Grant)

options.multi_tenancy_rls: Projects = tenants; RBAC policies per role; multi-instance or shared schema
options.custom_entities: Collections = tables; full CRUD + relations + flows
options.notes: Strong data-first admin; free self-host for qualifying orgs. Good alternative if not using Medusa.

options.name: Novu / Trigger.dev (Notifications + Workflows only)

pricing.model: Novu: Free 10k runs, Pro $30/mo, Team $250/mo, Ent custom; Trigger: Free $5 credits, Hobby $10, Pro $50, Ent custom

options.audit_logs: Novu Team+ (RBAC + audit); Trigger Enterprise (RBAC + SOC2)
options.notes: Complementary for notifications/durable execution, not an admin console replacement.

options.name: WordPress Admin (Multisite / GrabWP Tenancy)

pricing.model: Free core; GrabWP Tenancy Pro paid (contact); hosting varies

options.multi_tenancy_rls: Multisite (shared DB, shared tables) or GrabWP Tenancy (isolated DB per tenant)
options.custom_entities: Custom post types + ACF / Meta Box; limited to WP data model
options.notes: Only viable if WordPress sites are the primary product. Not a platform admin.

recommended_architecture.rationale: Medusa Admin scores 18/20 on commerce domain fit; Refine scores 19/20 on platform domain fit. Combined ~93 weighted. Avoids second monolith via shared PG schema + RLS + dual API mount.

components.commerce_admin: Medusa Admin v2 extended with UI Routes for parse runs, mapping, margin rules
components.platform_console: Next.js 15 + Refine (Ant Design) + shadcn/ui for proposals, reconciliation, marketplace connectors, WordPress fleet, alerts, demand briefs
components.shared_api: Medusa Admin API (/admin) + Platform API (/platform) on same Medusa backend
components.auth_rbac: Medusa Auth + Platform JWT; CASL abilities from role_policy; PG RLS via app.current_tenant
components.audit: pgaudit + audit_log table (insert-only trigger on all write tables)
components.impersonation: Platform admin 'View as Tenant' sets app.current_tenant; logged in audit_log

tasks: PostgreSQL schema with tenant_id on all tables + RLS policies
CASL policy loader (roles → abilities) seeded from role_policy
Medusa v2 backend with Store Module (multi-store = tenant)

phase_1_mvp_admin.goal: One tenant, one supplier, end-to-end parse → price → publish → list → order → reconcile

tasks: Tenant-scoped Refine portal (white-labelled) for supplier onboarding, mapping, margin rules, listing review
Medusa Admin remains platform-only; tenants get simplified Merchant Portal (Refine subset)

gaps_and_risks.risk: Medusa multi-tenancy RLS not native; community pattern may lag core updates
gaps_and_risks.mitigation: Pin Medusa version; contribute fixes upstream; test RLS on every upgrade
Shared design tokens (Tailwind + shadcn/ui); consistent sidebar patterns; single sign-on
1-week spike; use Refine CLI templates; pair with Medusa Admin SDK patterns
Partition audit_log by month; async write via pg_notify + worker

gaps_and_risks.risk: WordPress fleet health requires WP-CLI / REST API access per site
gaps_and_risks.mitigation: Build wp_site agent (Trigger.dev) that pushes health to platform API
